description: Source code for MAX17262 fuel gauge driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register read/write, sensor data conversion, channel data retrieval, and device initialization.

methods.name: max17262_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register value from the MAX17262 device via I2C.

methods.name: max17262_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register on the MAX17262 device via I2C.

methods.name: max17262_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific sensor channel data from the MAX17262 device.

methods.name: max17262_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data from the MAX17262 device registers.

methods.name: max17262_gauge_init
methods.description: Initializes the MAX17262 fuel gauge device.
